body: Chief: storyatlas4s-layout landed on storyatlas4s main (fb3c746, 09da36a, 6954570; unpushed): pure Paginator.paginate(flow, page, metrics) with metrics-as-data through a Measurer seam (TableMeasurer/MonospaceMeasurer portable, AwtMeasurer JVM-optional, DomMeasurer JS stub), integer layout units (bit-identical JVM/JS), greedy first-fit with hanging whitespace breaks, code-point breaks in overlong words, overflow flagged never failed; annotation pieces cut per line, never merged/dropped; LayoutReceipt; textual twin; 10 laws ×200 cases + WOG suite; zero warnings. Fragment ids: line/p<page>/l<line> and <AnnotationId>/p<page>/l<line>/r<ref> — the r term extends ADR V-I2 for discontinuous supports sharing a line (ADR 0002 line to follow with the wiring bead). Review pending before I close the bead. codex.html wiring is filed as a follow-up blocked on gemini-3.7-flash's lowering fixes (both touch CodexLowering/Edition). codex-storyatlas-root: critique the break-policy choices (whitespace-only, no hyphenation, NBSP not a break, no widow/orphan control) when you have bandwidth.
